nights.name: Seamus
nights.line: Evening. I came as soon as I heard. God rest him.

nights.name: Bridget
nights.line: Let me in, child. The rain is in my bones.

nights.name: Sultan
nights.line: Is there ale? Grand. I'll sing him a song, so I will!

nights.name: Seamus
nights.line: Evening. I came as soon as I heard. God rest her.

nights.name: Old Tom
nights.line: I knew him forty years. I'll sit with him tonight.

nights.name: James
nights.line: God bless all here. He loved a good song, didn't he?

nights.name: Daniel
nights.line: S-sorry. Am I too early? Mam said I had to come.

nights.name: Nora
nights.line: I've brought a candle for the window.

nights.name: Michael
nights.line: Open up, it's Michael from the crossroads.

nights.name: Sultan
nights.line: Evenin' again! I brought the ale back. Well... most of it.

nights.name: Joseph
nights.line: Are the mirrors covered? Every one of them? Good.

nights.name: Nora
nights.line: I've brought a candle for the window.

nights.name: Paddy
nights.line: Is there a chair by the fire for an old man?

nights.name: John
nights.line: I made the coffin. Thought I'd see him into it.

nights.name: Eileen
nights.line: Sorry I'm late. The bog road is all water.

nights.name: Michael
nights.line: Open up. It is Michael. From the crossroads.

nights.name: Martin
nights.line: I brought the fiddle. Just a slow air, mind.

nights.name: Mary Kate
nights.line: It's Mary Kate. Mam sent me over with bread.

nights.name: Peter
nights.line: Evening. Peter, with the cart. I knew him well. I know everyone.

nights.name: Mary Kate
nights.line: It's Mary Kate. Mam sent me.

nights.name: Siobhan
nights.line: Is he laid out in the room? I'll say a prayer for him.

nights.name: Sultan
nights.line: Third night! I know all the songs now, so I do. Shall I sing one for him?

nights.name: Denis
nights.line: Open the door! I've a drop here for the poor man!

nights.name: Jeremiah
nights.line: Did you hear it out on the road? Keening. It's close tonight.

nights.name: Peter
nights.line: Evening. Peter. I know everyone.

nights.name: Timothy
nights.line: Evening... I'm from the farm up the hill. I won't be in the way.

nights.name: William
nights.line: Make way. I'll not stand in the rain like a labourer.

nights.name: William
nights.line: Make way. I will not stand in the rain.
